sense.name: Blindsight
entries: A creature with {@sense Blindsight|sw5e-phb|blindsight} can {@optfeature Perceive|sw5e-phb|perceive} its surroundings without relying on sight, within a specific radius. Creatures without eyes, such as Miraluka, and creatures with echolocation or heightened senses, such as Togruta or Verpine, have this sense.

sense.name: Darkvision
entries: Many creatures in the worlds of Star Wars, especially those that dwell underground, have {@sense Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision}. Within a specified range, a creature with {@sense Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision} can see in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} as if the {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} were dim light, so areas of {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} are only lightly obscured as far as that creature is concerned. However, the creature can't discern color in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, only shades of gray.

sense.name: Tremorsense
entries: A creature with {@sense Tremorsense|sw5e-phb|tremorsense} can detect and pinpoint the origin of vibrations within a specific radius, provided that the creature and the source of the vibrations are in contact with the same ground or substance. {@sense Tremorsense|sw5e-phb} can't be used to detect flying or incorporeal creatures.

sense.name: Truesight
entries: A creature with {@sense Truesight|sw5e-phb|truesight} can, out to a specific range, see in normal and enhanced {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, see {@condition Invisible|sw5e-phb|invisible} creatures and objects, automatically detect visual illusions and succeed on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against them, and perceives the original form of a shapechanger or a creature that is transformed by a power.
